question: What is the correct unit of economic value in commercial signage — the fabricated artifact, the installation service, or the ongoing attention stream it generates?
summary: First-principles chain arrived independently at the attention-stream / CPM framing, which OOH advertising corpus confirms. Novel sub-claim: custom fabrication shops (unlike media networks) have not applied audience-adjusted pricing despite producing the same underlying product. Sign shops are in the impression-delivery business disguised as manufacturing.
